title: SAILOR: Solver-Assisted Interactive LLM-based Optimization Recovery
abstract: arXiv:2609.13945v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Natural-language descriptions of optimization problems may be incomplete or vague about numerical information that a solver requires, including costs, capacities, demands, bounds, and penalties. A language model can translate the description into code, but when a required value is absent it must either stop or guess. We present SAILOR, a proof-of-concept system that detects such unsupported numerical choices, asks the user targeted follow-up questions, and updates the optimization model before returning a solution. Questions are prioritized using uncertainty and solver-derived estimates of how strongly each missing value affects the current model. We evaluate the pipeline on 1,723 instances from seven masked benchmarks using an idealized simulator that returns ground-truth values. translated_title: SAILOR：基于求解器辅助的交互式大语言模型优化恢复
translated_abstract: 优化问题的自然语言描述可能不完整，或对求解器所需的数值信息（如成本、容量、需求、边界和惩罚等）描述模糊。语言模型可以将描述转化为代码，但当所需的数值缺失时，它只能停止或进行猜测。我们提出了SAILOR，这是一个概念验证系统，能够检测此类缺乏依据的数值选择，向用户提出有针对性的后续问题，并在返回解决方案之前更新优化模型。问题的优先级排序基于不确定性以及求解器推导出的各缺失值对当前模型影响程度的估计。我们在来自七个匿名基准数据集的1,723个实例上，使用返回真实值的理想化模拟器对该流程进行了评估。各数据集的目标值精确匹配率从27.0%到87.6%不等，平均每个实例需要提出1.4至5.7个问题。这些结果证明了该方法的可行性。
tldr: SAILOR提出了一个将大语言模型与求解器相结合的交互式系统，能够检测优化问题自然语言描述中缺失或模糊的数值信息，并基于不确定性和求解器推导的影响程度评估对提问进行优先级排序，通过针对性向用户提问补全缺失值后再更新模型求解。
en_tdlr: SAILOR introduces an interactive system that combines LLMs with solvers to detect missing or vague numerical information in natural-language optimization problem descriptions, and uses uncertainty and solver-derived impact estimates to prioritize targeted follow-up questions that recover missing values before solving the model.
